name: NOVALINERS REQUIREMENT REGISTRY SCHEMA v0.1
note: Grammar Requirement Registry — contract: internal-docs §5 (gelombang 1-3; GO Tahap 2 owner, 26 Sep 2026). Deklaratif mengikuti pola route_schema.json; di-enforce oleh ontology/registry/validate_registry.py. LARANGAN OWNER TAHAP 2: file ini dan fixtures TIDAK memuat 27 entri D4 — entry normalization & granularity = tahap 5/4. Guardrail terkunci: (1) mode = union sekaligus structural discriminator, validator TIDAK menilai kualitas isi partial; (2) RR9 linguistic = WARNING saja, tak pernah gagalkan entry; (3) structural-only benar-benar structural.

forbidden_fields.$comment: RR1 + RR3 + §5.2 — key DILARANG di SELURUH pohon entry (dicek rekursif). scope = milik Universal State; evidence_sources = evidence layer (RR6); route/strategy/execution/applicability/frontier/unlocks = layer lain.

banned_id_suffixes.$comment: D2 guardrail — suffix dari vocabulary status TERTUTUP yang sudah dikunci (RR4 satisfaction + banned route_schema + status path). Struktur lain (mis. _defined/_scored) = urusan normalisasi tahap 5 (mapping A<->B), BUKAN cek validator.

requirement_entry.description: 5 lapisan semantik (contract §5.1). NOL entri nyata di Tahap 2 — fixtures = contoh sintetis (prefix sample./bad./rr9.). Top-level keys PERSIS 5 lapisan; key lain = error.

requirement_id.note: dotted <domain>.<name> (D2) · tanpa suffix status (banned_id_suffixes) · RR2: identity stabil terhadap revisi wording/observability/rule/provenance

definition.note: WHAT — keadaan/post-condition yang harus benar (C1). BUKAN cara bukti, BUKAN instruksi (RR9 hard invariant)

observability.note: kondisi yang BISA diamati (bukan evidence user; bukan whitelist kaku — C1). RR9: kondisi dunia, bukan aktivitas pelaksanaan

provenance.note: RR6: requirement provenance SAJA (mengapa knowledge mendefinisikan WHAT ini) — evidence provenance = Universal State; evidence_sources DILARANG

satisfaction_rule.description: RR11 jangkar struktural (gelombang-3): union type mode = structural discriminator. Validator cek BENTUK, bukan isi (penilaian substantif = audit tahap 4).

mode.note: BINARY → field 'partial' DILARANG · PARTIAL → field 'partial' WAJIB (union consistency)

partial.note: evidence partial bermakna → PARTIAL (C3/RR11) — hanya legal saat mode=PARTIAL

no_decisive.note: no decisive evidence → UNKNOWN (C2/RR10 — bukan ABSENT)

contradicting.note: evidence contradicting → ABSENT — hanya dari evidence negatif, BUKAN absence of evidence (RR10/C2)

requirement_provenance.description: REUSE skema KB live (D5 — koreksi Temuan B: jangan skema paralel). source_id wajib terdaftar di ontology/knowledge/sources.json.

invariants.RR1: entry tanpa field forbidden (rekursif) — requirement = WHAT
invariants.RR2: requirement_id dotted + stabil (validator: bentuk; revisi definisi = urusan lineage, tahap 6+)
invariants.RR4: satisfaction_status closed set — status TIDAK hidup di registry (enum dicatat; entry tidak punya field status)
invariants.RR5: PARTIAL hanya via mode=PARTIAL + field partial terisi (kontainer dilarang by construction)
invariants.RR7: adjudicator authority — registry hanya mendefinisikan rule (struktur), bukan status
invariants.RR8: registry tidak menulis state — tidak ada field tulisan-ke-state
invariants.RR9: definition/observability = kondisi dunia — enforcement = linguistic WARNING best-effort, BUKAN error (guardrail owner)
invariants.RR10: contradicting (→ABSENT) wajib ada sebagai cabang rule terpisah dari no_decisive (→UNKNOWN)
invariants.RR11: mode union: BINARY↔tanpa partial · PARTIAL↔wajib partial — structural discriminator
